UK Heatwave 2026: Excess Mortality Explorer
// Map Container Component (Single Child Element)
viewof map = {
  const container = html`
    <div style="height: 100%; min-height: 720px; width: 100%; position: relative;">
      <div id="map-viewport" style="width: 100%; height: 100%;"></div>
      <div id="map-legend" class="map-legend"></div>
      <div id="map-spinner" style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 100;">
        <div style="text-align: center; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;">
          <div style="font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #b30000; margin-bottom: 6px;">Loading Vector Geometries...</div>
          <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b;">England & Wales Heatwave Mortality Model</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  yield container;

  const mapDiv = container.querySelector("#map-viewport");
  const spinner = container.querySelector("#map-spinner");

  const m = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: mapDiv,
    style: "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/positron-gl-style/style.json",
    bounds: [[-5.8, 50.0], [1.8, 55.8]],
    fitBoundsOptions: { padding: 25 }
  });

  m.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl({ showCompass: false }), "top-right");

  const popup = new maplibregl.Popup({
    closeButton: false,
    closeOnClick: false,
    className: "map-tooltip-popup"
  });

  m.on("load", () => {
    m.addSource("region_src", { type: "geojson", data: "app_data/geo_region.geojson" });
    m.addSource("lad_src",    { type: "geojson", data: "app_data/geo_lad.geojson" });
    m.addSource("lsoa_src",   { type: "geojson", data: "app_data/geo_lsoa.geojson" });

    const initPal = helpers.getMapPalette("region", "rate", "study_period");
    const initExpr = [
      "interpolate", ["linear"], ["coalesce", ["get", "rate_study_period"], 0],
      initPal.values[0], initPal.stops[0],
      initPal.values[1], initPal.stops[1],
      initPal.values[2], initPal.stops[2],
      initPal.values[3], initPal.stops[3],
      initPal.values[4], initPal.stops[4]
    ];

    m.addLayer({
      id: "region_layer",
      type: "fill",
      source: "region_src",
      layout: { visibility: "visible" },
      paint: { "fill-color": initExpr, "fill-opacity": 0.78, "fill-outline-color": "#1e293b" }
    });

    m.addLayer({
      id: "lad_layer",
      type: "fill",
      source: "lad_src",
      layout: { visibility: "none" },
      paint: { "fill-color": initExpr, "fill-opacity": 0.78, "fill-outline-color": "#64748b" }
    });

    m.addLayer({
      id: "lsoa_layer",
      type: "fill",
      source: "lsoa_src",
      layout: { visibility: "none" },
      paint: { "fill-color": initExpr, "fill-opacity": 0.82 }
    });

    m.addLayer({
      id: "region_highlight_layer",
      type: "line",
      source: "region_src",
      paint: { "line-color": "#b30000", "line-width": 3, "line-opacity": 0.95 },
      filter: ["==", "rgn11cd", ""]
    });

    for (const lyr of ["region_layer", "lad_layer", "lsoa_layer"]) {
      m.on("mousemove", lyr, (e) => {
        if (!e.features || !e.features.length) return;
        m.getCanvas().style.cursor = "pointer";
        const props = e.features[0].properties;
        const htmlContent = helpers.formatTooltip(lyr, props, helpers.period);
        popup.setLngLat(e.lngLat).setHTML(htmlContent).addTo(m);
      });

      m.on("mouseleave", lyr, () => {
        m.getCanvas().style.cursor = "";
        popup.remove();
      });

      m.on("click", lyr, (e) => {
        if (!e.features || !e.features.length) return;
        const props = e.features[0].properties;
        if (props.rgn11cd) {
          mutable selected_region = props.rgn11cd;
          mutable selected_region_name = props.rgn11nm || props.rgn11cd;
        }
      });
    }

    spinner.style.display = "none";
    container.value = m;
    container.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
    setTimeout(() => { if (m) m.resize(); }, 150);
  });

  window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (m) m.resize(); });
  invalidation.then(() => m.remove());
}
// Filterable Data Table
{
  const p = period;
  const sel_rgn = selected_region;
  const targetAge = age_group;

  const fmtInt = (x) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-GB");
  const fmtRate = (x, digits = 1) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-GB", { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });

  let data = summary_data.filter(x => x.period === p);
  if (sel_rgn !== "All") {
    data = data.filter(x => x.geo_level === "region" && x.rgn11cd === sel_rgn);
  }
  if (targetAge !== "all") {
    data = data.filter(x => x.agegr === targetAge);
  }

  const maxEst = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.estimate || 0), 1);
  const maxRate = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.rate || 0), 1);

  const downloadCsv = () => {
    const headers = ["geo_level", "rgn11cd", "rgn11nm", "period", "period_label", "agegr", "age", "population", "estimate", "lower", "upper", "rate", "ratelow", "ratehigh"];
    const csvRows = data.map(row => headers.map(h => {
      let v = row[h];
      if (typeof v === "number") v = Math.round(v * 100) / 100;
      if (typeof v === "string" && v.includes(",")) v = `"${v}"`;
      return v ?? "";
    }).join(","));
    const csvStr = [headers.join(","), ...csvRows].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csvStr], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `UK_Heatwave_2026_Summary.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const exportBtn = html`<button style="padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 11px; background: white; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; color: #b30000; font-weight: 600;">Export CSV</button>`;
  exportBtn.onclick = downloadCsv;

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%;">
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px;">
        <span style="font-size: 11.5px; color: #64748b; font-weight: 600;">
          Showing <b>${data.length}</b> records (${sel_rgn === "All" ? "National & Regions" : selected_region_name})
        </span>
        ${exportBtn}
      </div>

      <div style="overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px;">
        <table class="custom-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Geography</th>
              <th>Age Group</th>
              <th style="min-width: 140px;">Excess Deaths (95% eCI)</th>
              <th style="min-width: 140px;">Rate / M (95% eCI)</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            ${data.map(r => {
              const estPct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ((r.estimate || 0) / maxEst) * 100)).toFixed(1);
              const ratePct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ((r.rate || 0) / maxRate) * 100)).toFixed(1);
              const estText = `${fmtInt(r.estimate)} [${fmtInt(r.lower)} – ${fmtInt(r.upper)}]`;
              const rateText = `${fmtRate(r.rate, 1)} [${fmtRate(r.ratelow, 1)} – ${fmtRate(r.ratehigh, 1)}]`;

              return html`
                <tr>
                  <td><b>${r.rgn11nm}</b></td>
                  <td>${r.age}</td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="inline-bar-bg">
                      <div class="inline-bar-fill" style="width: ${estPct}%;"></div>
                      <span class="inline-bar-text">${estText}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="inline-bar-bg">
                      <div class="inline-bar-fill" style="width: ${ratePct}%;"></div>
                      <span class="inline-bar-text">${rateText}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              `;
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

// 1. Time Series Chart
{
  const p = period;
  const age = age_group;
  const fmtInt = (x) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-GB");

  const container = html`<div style="width: 100%; height: 320px;"></div>`;
  if (!window.Plotly) return container;

  let d;
  if (age === "age75plus") {
    const mapDate = new Map();
    const filtered = daily_data.filter(x => x.agegr === "age7584" || x.agegr === "age85plus");
    for (const row of filtered) {
      if (!mapDate.has(row.date)) {
        mapDate.set(row.date, { date: row.date, estimate: 0, lower: 0, upper: 0, meantemp: row.meantemp });
      }
      const entry = mapDate.get(row.date);
      entry.estimate += (row.estimate || 0);
      entry.lower += (row.lower || 0);
      entry.upper += (row.upper || 0);
    }
    d = Array.from(mapDate.values());
  } else {
    const targetAge = ["all", "age064", "age6574", "age7584", "age85plus"].includes(age) ? age : "all";
    d = daily_data.filter(x => x.agegr === targetAge);
  }

  const hwWindows = {
    hw1: ["2026-05-22", "2026-05-28"],
    hw2: ["2026-06-18", "2026-06-28"],
    hw3: ["2026-07-06", "2026-07-17"],
    hw4: ["2026-07-29", "2026-08-05"],
    hw5: ["2026-08-11", "2026-08-15"]
  };

  const shapes = Object.entries(hwWindows).map(([hw, bounds]) => {
    const isActive = (p === hw);
    return {
      type: "rect",
      fillcolor: isActive ? "rgba(179, 0, 0, 0.22)" : "rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08)",
      line: { color: isActive ? "#b30000" : "transparent", width: isActive ? 1.5 : 0 },
      x0: bounds[0], x1: bounds[1], xref: "x", y0: 0, y1: 1, yref: "paper"
    };
  });

  let xRange;
  if (hwWindows[p]) {
    const b = hwWindows[p];
    const d0 = new Date(b[0]); d0.setDate(d0.getDate() - 3);
    const d1 = new Date(b[1]); d1.setDate(d1.getDate() + 3);
    xRange = [d0.toISOString().slice(0, 10), d1.toISOString().slice(0, 10)];
  } else {
    xRange = ["2026-05-01", "2026-09-30"];
  }

  const traceBars = {
    x: d.map(x => x.date),
    y: d.map(x => x.estimate),
    type: "bar",
    name: "Excess Deaths",
    marker: { color: "#b30000", opacity: 0.85 },
    yaxis: "y"
  };

  const traceLine = {
    x: d.map(x => x.date),
    y: d.map(x => x.meantemp),
    type: "scatter",
    mode: "lines",
    name: "Mean Temp (°C)",
    line: { color: "#d97706", width: 2 },
    yaxis: "y2"
  };

  const layout = {
    shapes: shapes,
    xaxis: { title: "", range: xRange, showgrid: false },
    yaxis: { title: "Daily Deaths", zeroline: true, automargin: true },
    yaxis2: { title: "Temp (°C)", overlaying: "y", side: "right", showgrid: false, automargin: true },
    legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0.5, xanchor: "center", y: 1.15 },
    margin: { t: 25, r: 40, b: 35, l: 45 }
  };

  Plotly.newPlot(container, [traceBars, traceLine], layout, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false });
  return container;
}
// 2. Regional Comparison Chart
{
  const p = period;
  const m = metric;
  const targetAge = age_group;
  const rgn = selected_region;
  const fmtRate = (x, digits = 1) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-GB", { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });
  const fmtInt = (x) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-GB");

  const container = html`<div style="width: 100%; height: 320px;"></div>`;
  if (!window.Plotly) return container;

  const validAge = ["all", "age75plus", "age064", "age6574", "age7584", "age85plus"].includes(targetAge) ? targetAge : "all";
  let d = summary_data.filter(x => x.geo_level === "region" && x.period === p && x.agegr === validAge);

  if (m === "rate") {
    d.sort((a, b) => a.rate - b.rate);
  } else {
    d.sort((a, b) => a.estimate - b.estimate);
  }

  const xVal = (m === "rate") ? d.map(x => x.rate) : d.map(x => x.estimate);
  const arrMax = (m === "rate") ? d.map(x => x.ratehigh - x.rate) : d.map(x => x.upper - x.estimate);
  const arrMin = (m === "rate") ? d.map(x => x.rate - x.ratelow) : d.map(x => x.estimate - x.lower);
  const barColors = d.map(x => (rgn === "All" || x.rgn11cd === rgn) ? "#b30000" : "#cbd5e1");

  const trace = {
    y: d.map(x => x.rgn11nm),
    x: xVal,
    type: "bar",
    orientation: "h",
    marker: { color: barColors },
    error_x: { type: "data", symmetric: false, array: arrMax, arrayminus: arrMin, color: "#475569", thickness: 1.2 }
  };

  const layout = {
    xaxis: { title: m === "rate" ? "Rate per Million" : "Excess Deaths", automargin: true },
    yaxis: { title: "", automargin: true },
    margin: { l: 120, r: 20, t: 10, b: 35 }
  };

  Plotly.newPlot(container, [trace], layout, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false });
  return container;
}
// 3. Age Gradient Chart
{
  const p = period;
  const m = metric;
  const rgn = selected_region;

  const container = html`<div style="width: 100%; height: 320px;"></div>`;
  if (!window.Plotly) return container;

  let d = (rgn === "All")
    ? summary_data.filter(x => x.geo_level === "national" && x.period === p && ["age064", "age6574", "age7584", "age85plus"].includes(x.agegr))
    : summary_data.filter(x => x.geo_level === "region" && x.rgn11cd === rgn && x.period === p && ["age064", "age6574", "age7584", "age85plus"].includes(x.agegr));

  const ageOrder = ["0-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85 and above"];
  d.sort((a, b) => ageOrder.indexOf(a.age) - ageOrder.indexOf(b.age));

  const yVal = (m === "rate") ? d.map(x => x.rate) : d.map(x => x.estimate);
  const arrMax = (m === "rate") ? d.map(x => x.ratehigh - x.rate) : d.map(x => x.upper - x.estimate);
  const arrMin = (m === "rate") ? d.map(x => x.rate - x.ratelow) : d.map(x => x.estimate - x.lower);

  const trace = {
    x: d.map(x => x.age),
    y: yVal,
    type: "bar",
    marker: { color: ["#fca5a5", "#f87171", "#ef4444", "#b30000"] },
    error_y: { type: "data", symmetric: false, array: arrMax, arrayminus: arrMin, color: "#334155", thickness: 1.2 }
  };

  const layout = {
    xaxis: { title: "Age Group", automargin: true },
    yaxis: { title: m === "rate" ? "Rate per Million" : "Excess Deaths", automargin: true },
    margin: { t: 15, r: 20, b: 35, l: 50 }
  };

  Plotly.newPlot(container, [trace], layout, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false });
  return container;
}

Public Health Notice:
Figures presented are modelled statistical estimates of heat-related excess mortality derived from historical temperature–mortality relationships (DLNM, lags 0–21 days) and ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis temperatures across 34,753 LSOAs, not counts from death certificates.

Key Findings: * 5,827 excess deaths (95% eCI: 4,349–6,897) across England & Wales from 1 May to 30 September 2026 (97.6 per million). * Episodic concentration: 91.4% of total heat mortality (5,325 deaths) occurred within the five discrete heatwaves (HW1–HW5). * Vulnerable older adults: Adults aged 75+ accounted for 75.7% of all excess deaths (4,408 deaths). * Regional rates: West Midlands (133.9/M), South East (133.0/M), and London (132.4/M) suffered the highest rates; North East (41.7/M) the lowest.

// Helpers for Map Palette, Columns and Tooltips
helpers = {
  function getMapPalette(lvl, m, p) {
    const stops = ["#fef0d9", "#fdcc8a", "#fc8d59", "#e34a33", "#b30000"];
    let values, title;
    if (m === "rate") {
      values = [0, 25, 60, 120, 200];
      title = "Deaths per Million";
    } else {
      title = "Excess Deaths";
      if (lvl === "lsoa") {
        values = (p === "study_period") ? [0, 0.2, 0.6, 1.5, 3.0] : [0, 0.05, 0.15, 0.4, 1.0];
      } else if (lvl === "lad") {
        values = (p === "study_period") ? [0, 5, 15, 30, 60] : [0, 2, 6, 12, 25];
      } else {
        values = (p === "study_period") ? [0, 100, 300, 700, 1200] : [0, 25, 75, 150, 300];
      }
    }
    return { values, stops, title };
  }

  function getActiveCol(lvl, m, p) {
    const prefix = (m === "rate") ? "rate_" : "estimate_";
    let suffix = p;
    if (lvl === "lsoa") {
      suffix = (p === "study_period") ? "total_hw" : p;
    } else if (lvl === "lad") {
      suffix = (p === "study_period") ? "study_period" : p;
    }
    return prefix + suffix;
  }

  const periodLabelMap = {
    "study_period": "1 May–30 September 2026",
    "hw1": "Heatwave 1 (22–28 May)",
    "hw2": "Heatwave 2 (18–28 June)",
    "hw3": "Heatwave 3 (6–17 July)",
    "hw4": "Heatwave 4 (29 July–5 August)",
    "hw5": "Heatwave 5 (11–15 August)"
  };

  const fmtInt = (x) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-GB");
  const fmtRate = (x, digits = 1) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-GB", { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });

  function formatTooltip(lyr, props, p) {
    const lbl = periodLabelMap[p] || p;
    if (lyr === "region_layer") {
      return `
        <div><strong>${props.rgn11nm || "Region"}</strong> <span style="color:#64748b;">(${props.rgn11cd})</span></div>
        <div style="margin-top: 4px;">Excess Deaths: <b>${fmtInt(props[`estimate_${p}`])}</b> <span style="font-size:11px;color:#64748b;">[95% eCI: ${fmtInt(props[`lower_${p}`])} – ${fmtInt(props[`upper_${p}`])}]</span></div>
        <div>Rate per Million: <b>${fmtRate(props[`rate_${p}`], 1)}</b> <span style="font-size:11px;color:#64748b;">[95% eCI: ${fmtRate(props[`ratelow_${p}`], 1)} – ${fmtRate(props[`ratehigh_${p}`], 1)}]</span></div>
        <div style="font-size:10px; color:#94a3b8; margin-top:3px;">${lbl}</div>
      `;
    } else if (lyr === "lad_layer") {
      const estCol = (p === "study_period") ? "estimate_study_period" : `estimate_${p}`;
      const rateCol = (p === "study_period") ? "rate_study_period" : `rate_${p}`;
      return `
        <div><strong>${props.lad11nm || "Local Authority"}</strong> <span style="color:#64748b;">(${props.lad11cd})</span></div>
        <div style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">Region: ${props.rgn11nm || "—"}</div>
        <div style="margin-top: 3px;">Excess Deaths: <b>${fmtRate(props[estCol], 1)}</b></div>
        <div>Rate per Million: <b>${fmtRate(props[rateCol], 1)}</b></div>
        <div style="font-size:10px; color:#94a3b8; margin-top:3px;">${lbl}</div>
      `;
    } else {
      const estCol = (p === "study_period") ? "estimate_total_hw" : `estimate_${p}`;
      const rateCol = (p === "study_period") ? "rate_total_hw" : `rate_${p}`;
      return `
        <div><strong>${props.lsoa11nm || props.lsoa11cd}</strong> <span style="color:#64748b;">(${props.lsoa11cd})</span></div>
        <div style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">${props.lad11nm || "—"} | ${props.rgn11nm || "—"}</div>
        <div style="margin-top: 3px;">Excess Deaths: <b>${fmtRate(props[estCol], 2)}</b></div>
        <div>Rate per Million: <b>${fmtRate(props[rateCol], 1)}</b></div>
        <div style="font-size:10px; color:#94a3b8; margin-top:3px;">${lbl}</div>
      `;
    }
  }

  return { getMapPalette, getActiveCol, formatTooltip, period: "study_period" };
}
// Reactive Map Layer & Style Updates
{
  const m = map;
  const lvl = geo_level;
  const p = period;
  const met = metric;
  const rgn = selected_region;

  helpers.period = p;

  if (m && m.isStyleLoaded && m.isStyleLoaded()) {
    const layers = ["region_layer", "lad_layer", "lsoa_layer"];
    const targetLayer = `${lvl}_layer`;
    for (const lyr of layers) {
      if (m.getLayer(lyr)) {
        m.setLayoutProperty(lyr, "visibility", (lyr === targetLayer) ? "visible" : "none");
      }
    }

    const pal = helpers.getMapPalette(lvl, met, p);
    const colName = helpers.getActiveCol(lvl, met, p);
    const expr = [
      "interpolate", ["linear"], ["coalesce", ["get", colName], 0],
      pal.values[0], pal.stops[0],
      pal.values[1], pal.stops[1],
      pal.values[2], pal.stops[2],
      pal.values[3], pal.stops[3],
      pal.values[4], pal.stops[4]
    ];

    if (m.getLayer(targetLayer)) {
      m.setPaintProperty(targetLayer, "fill-color", expr);
    }

    if (m.getLayer("region_highlight_layer")) {
      const filter = (rgn === "All") ? ["==", "rgn11cd", ""] : ["==", "rgn11cd", rgn];
      m.setFilter("region_highlight_layer", filter);
    }
  }

  // Update Legend
  const pal = helpers.getMapPalette(lvl, met, p);
  const gradStops = pal.stops.map((c, i) => `${c} ${Math.round(i / (pal.stops.length - 1) * 100)}%`).join(", ");
  const legendEl = document.getElementById("map-legend");
  if (legendEl) {
    legendEl.innerHTML = `
      <div style="font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 4px;">${pal.title}</div>
      <div style="height: 12px; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(to right, ${gradStops}); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);"></div>
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #64748b; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 3px;">
        <span>${pal.values[0]}</span>
        <span>${pal.values[2]}</span>
        <span>${pal.values[4]}+</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}
